newsitem.title: USA: Columbia accelerates lower natgas rates.
newsitem.headline: Columbia accelerates lower natgas rates.

text.p: Columbia Gas of Ohio said Friday it will implement a 13 percent reduction in gas bills a week earlier than originally announced.
The company said the reduction will be effective with bills mailed March 24, instead of April 1, as originally planned.

Columbia said it was not scheduled to make its next gas cost adjustment until May, but because gas prices have decreased in the marketplace Columbia filed earlier this month to pass along savings to customers as soon as possible.
The average residential customer using 10,000 cubic feet of gas (10 Mcf) a month will see a decrease of approximately $10.30 a month, from $80.62 to $70.32.
Columbia of Ohio is a unit of the Columbia Gas System.
